resources.string: Two players take turns on one phone. More cells wins.

Cells you reveal and mines you mark correctly are yours. A safe cell marked as a mine and a mine that goes off go to your opponent. The start area belongs to nobody. The match ends with the last safe cell. Walls as in free play.
Tap: reveal · double tap: mark a mine
Tap: reveal · hold: mark a mine
Mines nobody found: %1$d. They belong to nobody.
The score of this match will be lost.
This territory match will be lost, and the players will start on a new board.

In a territory match two players take turns on one phone. Cells you reveal and mines you mark correctly are yours. A safe cell marked as a mine and a mine that goes off go to your opponent. The match ends with the last safe cell, and mines nobody found belong to nobody. Whoever owns more cells wins.
Each player has 5 moves. More points wins.

Player 1 makes all 5 moves first, then player 2. A revealed cell scores its number, plus 1 for each cell revealed with it. A mine marked correctly +3, a wrong mark −3, a mine that goes off −5. On a tie each player makes one more move until someone leads. Walls as in free play.
This war will be lost, and the players will start on a new board.

Player 1 makes all 5 moves first, then player 2 makes theirs. A revealed cell scores its number, plus 1 point for each cell revealed with it. A mine marked correctly gives 3 points, a wrong mark takes 3, and a mine that goes off takes 5. Whoever has more points wins. On a tie each player makes one more move until someone takes the lead. The war ends at once with the last safe cell, and mines nobody found score for nobody.
